description: This file contains rules and objects related to handling SQL hints in Apache Spark's Catalyst optimizer, including resolution of join strategy hints, coalesce hints, repartition hints, and mechanisms to remove or disable hints.

classes.name: ResolveHints
classes.description: Object containing rules for resolving and removing SQL hints in Spark Catalyst.

classes.name: ResolveHints.ResolveJoinStrategyHints
classes.description: Rule for resolving join strategy hints in logical plans.

classes.name: ResolveHints.ResolveCoalesceHints
classes.description: Rule for resolving coalesce, repartition, and rebalance hints.

classes.name: ResolveHints.RemoveAllHints
classes.description: Rule for removing all hints from logical plans.

classes.name: ResolveHints.DisableHints
classes.description: Rule for disabling hints based on configuration.

methods.name: createHintInfo
methods.description: Creates HintInfo object based on hint name.

methods.name: matchedIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a hint identifier matches a query relation identifier.

methods.name: extractIdentifier
methods.description: Extracts identifier parts from a SubqueryAlias.

methods.name: applyJoinStrategyHint
methods.description: Recursively applies join strategy hints to logical plan nodes.

methods.name: getNumOfPartitions
methods.description: Extracts number of partitions from hint parameters.

methods.name: createRepartition
methods.description: Creates a Repartition or RepartitionByExpression plan based on hint.

methods.name: createRepartitionByRange
methods.description: Creates a RepartitionByExpression for range partitioning.

methods.name: transformStringToAttribute
methods.description: Transforms string parameters in hints to UnresolvedAttribute.
